title: CodeReviewBench: An Automated Benchmark for Evaluating the Software Factory
abstract: arXiv:2611.26942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI agents ship more code with minimal human oversight, code review becomes the critical quality-control checkpoint -- but one without a reliable, objective verifier: review quality is nuanced and ultimately a judgment call by the PR author. Existing benchmarks are structurally misaligned with this: annotators are third-party reviewers, like the bots they evaluate, not the PR authors who actually decide what to fix. They also rely on small, static issue sets that require full re-evaluation as tools update, limiting how frequently progress can be tracked. We introduce CodeReviewBench, built on a fundamentally different signal: revealed developer preferences -- if a developer acts on a bot's suggestion, we treat it as useful; if they ignore it, we do not. translated_title: CodeReviewBench：一个用于评估软件工厂的自动化基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体在极少人工监督下交付更多代码，代码审查成为关键的质控关卡——但这一环节缺乏可靠、客观的验证机制：审查质量微妙且最终是PR作者的主观判断。现有基准测试在结构上与此不符：其标注者是第三方审查者（如同被评估的机器人一样），而非真正决定修复哪些内容的PR作者。此外，现有基准依赖小型、静态的问题集，当工具更新时需要完全重新评估，限制了追踪进展的频率。我们提出CodeReviewBench，它建立在一种根本不同的信号之上：开发者揭示的偏好——如果开发者采纳了机器人的建议，我们将其视为有用；如果他们忽略它，我们则不视为有用。这一信号每日从公开的GitHub事件流中挖掘，获得覆盖18个工具的50万+条经过判定的PR，并随工具演进持续刷新。我们验证了开发者偏好……
tldr: 该论文提出CodeReviewBench，以“开发者揭示的偏好”（开发者是否实际采纳机器人的审查建议）作为客观验证信号，每日从GitHub事件流挖掘50万+条判定数据，构建了一个可持续自动更新、覆盖18个工具的代码审查基准。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CodeReviewBench, an automated and continuously refreshing code review benchmark built on "revealed developer preferences"—mining daily from the GitHub event stream whether developers act on or ignore bot suggestions—to objectively evaluate code review tools across 500K+ judged PRs and 18 tools.
